title: AI Engineer
summary: Hi, I'm Zubair Ahmed, an AI Engineer with hands-on experience in machine learning, deep learning, AI-driven automation, and data analysis. I’ve worked across healthcare tech, generative AI, embedded systems, and computer vision. From developing EMG-based neural control systems in my FYP (Neuro-Flex) to building intelligent tools like UIgenius and an AI-powered Resume Screening Bot and my latest development of personal AI voice agent, I focus on creating practical, data-backed solutions that solve real-world problems.
focus: I specialize in transforming complex ideas into scalable AI systems—whether it's NLP, LLMs, RAGs, computer vision, or automation pipelines. I’m currently exploring advanced LLM applications, AI agents, and multimodal systems, aiming to build innovative and future-oriented technologies that accelerate human productivity.
hobbies: Outside of engineering, I enjoy exploring emerging AI trends, experimenting with new models, participating in technical projects, and continuously expanding my skill set. My long-term goal is to contribute to impactful AI systems that enhance accessibility, efficiency, and everyday human experiences.
